answer: A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, thus paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. Cosignatures are collected in karst, verified in inlet, and knoll names every witness. Each submission needs cosignature from 4 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 15 submissions per epoch. Repeating the trick 59 times costs 59 separate deposits and 14 separate proofs of work. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
